user.title: Connect to Qubo
user.description: Enter the email and password of your Qubo account (the same one used in the Qubo mobile app). An email-registered account is required: Qubo only issues long-lived refresh tokens to email accounts, which this integration needs for unattended 24/7 polling.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Qubo cloud service
error.rate_limited: Qubo's cloud is temporarily rate-limiting login attempts ("Login Limit reached"). Wait a few minutes before trying again.

abort.already_configured: This Qubo account is already configured
